titles_en.title: Even if the Flowers are Gone

description:
At the end of the cold continent, Onran is a warm country ruled by gods. Inok, a foreigner, could not forget the image of the king he saw as a child, so he applied for the royal guard, was accepted, and became a guard.  

And on the Lunar New Year's Day, the biggest holiday in the whole country, we finally come face to face with the king, Raan, but Raan has changed so much, unlike Enoch's memories...
